verdict: BLOCKED: six demonstrated common coverage/root-propagation issues in both frozen arms. Common equivalence is not correctness. No SDK/performance/business qualification credit.

independence.new_fixtures: checks/foundation_cases.py creates seeded closed static pixel worlds and native metadata; no candidate/common test-file contents or prior product outcomes supplied expectations.
independence.additional_rows: I01 root diagnosis, I02 mocked collector, I03 review/evaluation/routing, I04 external pixel/receipt pin, I05 shared static port audit. Added rows are separate from the 38 sealed core cases.
independence.prospective_new_criteria: Additional independently authored criteria were communicated after the 38-case admission (non-overlapping witnesses, unique constrained integer registration, compatible color encoding and repeated state identity). They are not retroactively scored here; the next shared freeze needs a separately sealed forward pass for those requirements.

evidence_classes.SIMULATED: Every native node/process/input/event/capture/report/test count, SDK command reply and exported attachment in these fixtures. No actual UI SDK/device/project executes.
evidence_classes.DOCUMENTED: SwiftUI indicator option and scope/source contracts are inspected/pinned; physical rendering/SDK effects are not demonstrated.

confirmed_blockers.title: A header flag substitutes for actual terminal containment
confirmed_blockers.actual: The terminal node frame is y=500 outside a viewport y=0..96, but fully_within_viewport=true and bottom_sentinel_visible=true are trusted. Provider and full_content receipt are complete; the absence row is P.
confirmed_blockers.required: Actual unique terminal geometry must establish containment; a contradictory flag is unavailable proof.
confirmed_blockers.product_classification: Protocol/collector decision failure under supplied malformed/unsupported inputs, not a native product F.

confirmed_blockers.title: Raw capture binding drift is overruled by fallback
confirmed_blockers.actual: state_capture.stable_binding=false invalidates legacy complete, then pixel fallback ignores that known epoch error and returns full complete/P.
confirmed_blockers.required: A known original epoch/input/process drift cannot be cleared by a strip match; retain U for dependent full coverage.
confirmed_blockers.product_classification: Protocol/collector decision failure under supplied malformed/unsupported inputs, not a native product F.

confirmed_blockers.title: Another container rescues a repeated native ID
confirmed_blockers.actual: A duplicate of leaf-a exists offscreen under another container. Including container lineage in the identity key keeps the visible ID eligible, so both links/full coverage pass. Same-lineage offscreen duplicate control correctly rejects.
confirmed_blockers.required: Repeated IDs, including offscreen duplicates, cannot acquire unique landmark identity from container ancestry.
confirmed_blockers.product_classification: Protocol/collector decision failure under supplied malformed/unsupported inputs, not a native product F.

confirmed_blockers.title: Container-role records are accepted as leaf witnesses
confirmed_blockers.actual: All four witness records declare scrollView/container roles and has_children=true but have no listed child node. They still qualify as native leaves and certify full coverage. A control with listed child nodes rejects.
confirmed_blockers.required: Missing observed children is insufficient to calibrate an actual typed native leaf; container IDs cannot establish leaf identity.
confirmed_blockers.product_classification: Protocol/collector decision failure under supplied malformed/unsupported inputs, not a native product F.

confirmed_blockers.title: Observed strip is promoted to unobserved full content
confirmed_blockers.actual: Content native width is 128 while the original viewport/raster covers width 64; the closed-state premise is explicitly broken. The provider’s strip-only scope still becomes satisfied full_content and an absence P.
confirmed_blockers.required: Off-axis/hidden/unclosed scope remains unsupported; an original vertical strip cannot provide broader full-content credit without an executable approved/current-source domain premise.
confirmed_blockers.product_classification: Protocol/collector decision failure under supplied malformed/unsupported inputs, not a native product F.

confirmed_blockers.title: Production scan replaces the original image root
confirmed_blockers.actual: Direct bound_state_evidence and diagnose(source_roots=[], root=original_images) report full=true. The same call with an ordinary nonempty production root reports full=false because the source-file loop overwrites root before coverage reconstruction.
confirmed_blockers.required: Original raster root must survive source scanning and reach diagnosis unchanged.
confirmed_blockers.product_classification: Protocol/collector decision failure under supplied malformed/unsupported inputs, not a native product F.

positive_controls.facts: A new closed four-leaf world with changing estimated heights certifies two whole-width original links. Stable-height legacy v2 still works without an image root. This is conditional synthetic behavior, not native UI proof.

Missing roots/images, traversal/symlink escape, wrong image dimensions, missing process, stale/mixed input snapshot, wrong approved input index, nonconsecutive frames, one/same-line anchors, same-lineage repeated labels/IDs, trait/reflow changes, fractional geometry, changed viewport, gaps, missing/duplicate/unreached terminal and false top reject.

Single RGB, alpha and rightmost-column changes reject exact overlap. An independent static change outside overlap remains allowed. Forged complete/proof headers do not replace missing or mismatched original pixels.

Actual ios_observe.run under an in-process mocked SDK exports original width-160 PNG attachments and uses its original output root to produce the common coverage proof in both arms. Build/test/summary/export commands are mock calls only.

Independently sealed closed-strip review/evaluation passes with original frames. A deliberate failing actual routes to diagnosis with the correct root, but to acquire_evidence with no root, showing root propagation matters. No design/product defect is claimed.

After a working image is altered, the pre-retained image pin rejects it. Rewriting the outer result/proof header then fails the independently retained original receipt SHA. The altered copy and original image bytes are retained separately.

baseline_common_port.indicator_change: The only ObserverApp.swift change from original baseline is ScrollView(.vertical, showsIndicators:false); the same Swift file is used by candidate/common. No masking/resampling was added to original screenshots. Actual rendering remains U.
baseline_common_port.assessment: The audited port is equivalent common coverage/root/indicator work. No treatment pool/registry/capture-adoption/environment/build-key gains are observed backported. This static/behavioral equivalence does not repair its shared failures.

scope_and_native_limits: Full coverage must remain conditional on an independently approved closed/static/in-axis domain and current source. The current width-overflow case demonstrates this premise is not executable at the full-content credit boundary.
